title: Deskwisp: AI employees for your back office
excerpt: AI agents with their own computer, email and memory. Chat or call them and the work gets done. Free for Windows.
content_html:
AI agents for small business

Deskwisp gives your small business a team of AI agents. Each one works on its own computer, with its own email and memory. Ask in a chat, and the work gets done. Nothing goes out without your OK.

Free plan. Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. From deskwisp.com or the Microsoft Store.

WispyChief of Staff

Inside every AI agent

A desk of its own.

  • A cloud computerA real desktop in the cloud with up to 4 screens. Watch your AI agent work live, or take the mouse.

  • A work email addressForward it a thread or copy it in. It reads, does the work and replies (Pro and Max).

  • A voice you can callCall it from the app and talk the task through, hands-free.

  • Memory of your businessCustomers, prices, suppliers and how you like things done, kept across every chat.

  • Human approval built inIt looks things up right away. Sending, buying and deleting wait for your OK.

  • A phone numberA US or Canadian number on your own AgentPhone account: people text or call your agent on it.

An AI assistant on every channel

Reach it where you work.

Message your AI assistant in the Deskwisp app, on iMessage or by text, in Telegram, Discord or Slack, send it an email, or call it by voice. It's the same agent with the same memory everywhere, so nothing gets lost between apps.

APP · IMESSAGE · SMS · TELEGRAM · DISCORD · SLACK · EMAIL · VOICE

AI agent vs AI chatbot

Chatbots answer. Agents finish.

A chatbot hands you a reply to copy and paste. A Deskwisp AI agent opens the apps, does the task and tells you when it's done.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

What is Deskwisp?

Deskwisp is a Windows app that gives your small business a team of AI agents, sometimes called AI employees. Each agent works on its own cloud computer, can have its own work email address and a voice, remembers your business, and handles back-office work such as the inbox, invoices and payment reminders, lead follow-ups and reports. You chat with it or call it, and it asks before it sends, buys or deletes anything.

What's the difference between an AI agent and an AI chatbot?

A chatbot answers in a chat window and leaves the work to you. An AI agent does the work: a Deskwisp agent opens the apps and websites it needs on its own computer, writes and files things, and reports back when it's done.

Is it safe to let an AI agent use my email and accounts?

Deskwisp agents look things up straight away, but sending, creating, buying and deleting wait for your OK. You can watch an agent's computer live and take over the mouse at any time.

What can a Deskwisp AI agent do?

Anything you'd do at a computer for your business: answer and sort email, chase unpaid invoices, follow up with leads, keep a sheet or CRM up to date, research suppliers and competitors, book calls and write the weekly report.

What's AI credit?

It's what your agents spend on the AI models they think and talk with. Every plan comes with some each month, and you can add more in the app when they've been busy.

What are computer hours?

The time your agents' cloud computer is working for them. It sleeps when nothing's using it, and the hours start over each month.

Can I change or cancel my plan?

Yes, whenever you like, in the app under Account and usage.

Does it work on a Mac or on my phone?

The app is for Windows 10 and 11. From your phone, you can talk to your agents in Telegram, Discord, Slack or by email.

Your first AI agent is free.

Download Deskwisp for Windows, sign in and give Wispy its first task. The app keeps itself up to date.

Download for Windows

Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. If Windows asks before the first install, choose More info, then Run anyway. The Microsoft Store version installs without that question and updates through the Store.
